lines: Mari and Kurenai were walking through the streets of the shady city.
But still... to wish for something like this. I just don't get it.
Ahaha... Why not? Ah! There it is!
That's the sign of the bar that you were talking about, Kurenai-san!
Yeah. It's a pretty decent spot for this area, relatively speaking.
And like that, the two of them walked into the shady-looking bar together.
Only Mari and Kurenai, however. The "Book Djinn" was nowhere to be seen.
And as for the reason these two were looking for a bar in a city of darkness...
...What? You want to have a drink...??
『Yes. I believe it's been called ambrosia, or perhaps the nectar of the gods?』
『I would like to taste it just onceー It has been my dream since an age ago.』
The djinn calmly replied to Kurenai who was lost for words.
This was his answer to what he himself wanted to do.
That's it? Then why don't you just give yourself as much booze as you want?
If you want, I can buy you Super Strong or something at a convenience store.
『Fufu, I appreciate your offer... but it's not that simple.』
『Because I don't have what you would call a "body."』
『To be able to have a drink, I would have to possess someone and borrow their body.』
I see... So that's what you want to do, Djinn-san.
Then I guess we won't be able to do it after all.
There's no one who would be interested in lending their body to a suspicious being like you.
『...I'm sure you're right. That is also the reason why I have never had the chance to have a drink beforeー』
Mari energetically raised her hand in the air.
I'll lend my body to you, Djinn-san! If that's all it takesーthen I will gladly repay the favor!!
For crying out loud... I already thought that you were a bit odd, but I didn't expect you to be this reckless.
Kurenai sighed. But Mari didn't seem to be bothered at all and simply laughed bashfully.
『I am grateful to you, Mari. Thanks to you, my wish will come true.』
Djinn-san! Don't worry about it... Please just enjoy yourself today♪
From Mari's mouth, the voice of the djinn that had possessed her could be heard.
It was somehow surreal to hear the voices of two different people alternately coming out of one person's mouth.
『My thanks to you as well. I didn't expect you to give me grace.』
...That's because it seems like you did save Mari after all.
But just for a short while. And if you do anything weird, I'll cut you down right away.
Mari could feel the djinn in her body gently smile.
I-It's going to be fine! Djinn-san's... already too weak to do anything like that.
Mari tried to reassure Kurenai. Now that she was being possessed by the djinn, she could tell how much power he had already lost.
I see. Then there shouldn't be a problem...
As they talked, the two of them stepped into the bar.
It was a cheap bar where mercenaries, demons, and other ruffians gathered.
Even at this hour it was already full, and the air was filled with the sound of vulgar laughter and yelling.
Uwah... It looks pretty dangerous here. Didn't you say... this was a decent place...?
Then how would a bar that wasn't relatively decent look like...?
Mari thought as she timidly looked around.
Hey, hey!? Look at those bitches over there!!
It was some drunken Orc mercenaries who had been hanging around the bar.
With mugs filled to the brim in their hands, they stood before Mari and Kurenai.
Hehe, maybe they're whores looking for customers? They look like they can make some lewd-ass faces...
Hey, girls, how much!? If you want, we'll play with you for a bitー
Don't touch me. You stinking pig.
Kurenai slapped away the orc's hand as he reached out to her arm with a vulgar grin on his face.
After a short moment of silence, the bar went into an uproar.
The other mercenaries, who had been laughing at Kurenai and Mari until a second ago, all stood up as the mood suddenly changed.
Uwahwahwah!? W-Will this be alright, Kurenai-san!?
Kurenai just shrugged her shoulders. And thenー
...Bwahaha!! Calling me stinking wasn't very nice, Kurenai-chan!
Even we take a bath once a month!!!
That's not enough. At least make it once a week.
Gyahahaha!! You're as harsh as ever!!!
And calling an Orc a pig isn't politically correct, is it!? Isn't that racism!?
Yeah! Don't take the resentment of the vulnerable and weak so lightly!!!
Really... Where did you even learn those words.
As Kurenai sighed deeply, the Orcs around her burst out laughing.
It was such a peaceful atmosphere, completely turned on its head from just a moment ago.
Since Kurenai brought someone new with her, we just wanted to pull her leg a bit!!
Mari turned around to see a large Orc who appeared to be the leader of the group.
Hehe... Sorry to startle you. I've known these guys for a while.
That's right! She sometimes works with us mercenaries, y'know.
And that's how we came to have a drink together once in a while.
Mari nodded with a relieved look on her face.
Well... that means you don't have to be scared, Mari.
They don't know manners and reek like fish at that, but they won't harm you unless you provoke them. They're good like that.
Even among demons and villains, you sometimes find guys like these.
What's going on, Kurenai-chan!? You're acting so cheeky today, do you want to play with us after all!?
Hmph, who'd play with someone like you.
That's right! And Kurenai-chan already has a prince she's after, isn't that right!?
Wha-!? You idiot! Don't say that!
The mercenaries were jeering and laughingー
But Kurenai, for some reason suddenly red in the face, forcibly changed the subject.
W-Well... anyways! We had a lot going on today, so I've brought one of my Taimanin friends with me.
You guys be nice to her, ok?
Ah! Nice to meet you, everyone! I'm Shinohara Mari!!
When Mari politely bowed her head, the mercenaries cheered loudly.
Yeah, nice to meet you! Taimanin Mari-chan!!
Gehehe! Glasses and big tits! And also pretty cute! She's the perfect girl!!
Gahaha!! Don't trouble the little lady!!
One of the Orc mercenaries raised his mug as he let out a hearty laugh.
Let's have a welcome toast!! Time to drink the night away boys!
The cheers of the rowdy mercenaries roared through the bar.
The mercenaries' feast continued, and the small bar was filled with a cheerful mood.
Uuhh... They all say whatever they damn well please... even though I'm also dealing with a lot...
I know what you mean, Kurenai-chan. The world isn't always kind to you huh.
Kurenai, who seemed to get sentimental when she was drunk, was venting to one of the Orcs.
And not just Kurenai, but the other mercenaries also seemed to be beyond tipsy.
Ah, Djinn-san. Did you like the drink?
At the corner of the festivities, Mari's cheeks had flushed red as well.
She was letting the djinn enjoy his first drink after giving up control of her body to him.
『Yes, very much so... The taste of the drink, and also the revelry of drinking with your companions...』
『I think I have begun to understand why people tend to gather like this...』
Fufu, you're right. Kurenai-san and the Orcs, they all seem to be enjoying themselves...
Dirty jokes and vulgar shoutsーthe inside of the bar was filled with the joyful smiles of the mercenaries.
『There seems to be something bothering you.』
Th-That's not true... I'm also really enjoying myself, just like the others...
After hesitating for a moment, the djinn continued to speak.
『I apologize for only telling you now, but... I have a certain power.』
『Only vaguely, but... the power to peer into people's minds and see their wishes.』
It was a byproduct of the djinn's power to fulfill wishes.
(I see... So that's how Djinn-san knew that I was a Taimanin when we first met...)
『I had to ask because deep inside you, it seemed like you were worrying about something...』
In fact, what the djinn said was right on the mark.
She had been worried that she was falling behind the other student Taimanin and she would never be able to catch up.
During today's fight against the Red Oni as well she had screwed up and had ended up being saved by the djinn. And alsoー
When she saw Kurenai, who was only slightly older than her, fighting so well and even well-respected by the mercenaries,
Mari couldn't help but feel even more inadequate...
It's... it's nothing! More importantly, drink a bit more, Djinn-san!
Don't worry about me and drink as much as you want♪
『...Yes, I will do that. Thank you, Mari...』
Smiling to himself, the djinn within Mari reached for a new glass.
ーUntil they heard a sudden clamor.
Uh-huh-huh-huh-huh!! You're in my way, you drunkard!!
So thiz iz where you've been hiding!? I found you, you dimwitz!
Who had appeared was a giant Oni, very similar to the one Mari had fought earlier, and more gangstersー
Now then, you Taimanin girlz over there!!
Give me all the information about the djinn before you get hurt! If you don'tー
Hey, hey, what's going on!? Are you trying to pick a fight with our drinking buddies!?
The Orc mercenaries in the bar stood up all at once with a look in their eyes as if to say they were ready for a war.
